Off the Hook: Level 2, Andy's house (not the Toy Box). To return to the story: Start › Exit to Game Board.
Carnival Conqueror: Level 4. Get at least bronze in the 3 minigames and then talk to Lotso, the pink bear.
Making a break for it: Level 6. Pops when you rescue the third prisoner (Rex, Hamm and Slinky).
Muffin Massacre: Final boss: run up the slope toward the bakery, the big muffin's shockwave cannot climb slopes. Then alternate the laser cannon (small witches) and the cow cannon (big witch), grabbing ammo and health between phases.
No Toy Left Behind: Rescue all the orphans on the Train
Level 1. There are 6 and they are all on the way: get close and press [□] so Buzz carries them off.
Space Ranger Elite: Reach Zurg's base without losing all your health
Level 3. Do this run without collectibles. Use the geysers to skip fights, kill the spiders first and take it slow on the moving platforms (you can hover).
True Carny: Achieve gold on all carnival games
Level 4: Twitch (balloons), Sparks (Teeny Racer) and Chunk (Alley Throw). They also give you 3 cards.
Sneaky Sneaky: Finish the Prison Break without ever tripping an alarm
Level 6. Before moving, switch to Buzz to see where he is watching. Go table to table between the lights and learn the pattern of the 4 ceiling lights.
Mapnipulator: Explore all the objects on the map
On the game board, hover the crayon and press [X] on the 7 objects: dice, yellow boat, checkers, fish, cannon, chest and chess piece.
The Collector: Gather every collectible in the game
Only story mode counts, not the Toy Box.
Townspeople Hunter: Woody (level 1), Jessie (2), Buzz (3), Daycare figure (4) and Blue Dog (5).
We can rebuild him: All 4 are in level 4: head, body, cape and gun.
No Claw Required: Alien prisoner (level 6), alien Zurg (7) and alien witch (8).
Welcome to Town: Follow Hamm: destroy the old shack, break 3 more, give an alien a hat, paint a building, talk to Stinky Pete and mine your first gold vein.
First Sale: Buy a toy from the Toy Store
The Toy Store is Al's Toy Barn chicken machine. Bullseye ($1,000) is the usual first buy.
Toy Collector: Purchase every item in the Toy Store
About $50,000 in total. Gold veins respawn, so money is never short. The cow cannon and UFO gun unlock by completing card sets in story mode.
Pack Collector: Purchase every customization pack from the Toy Store
Check the customization packs section of the Toy Store.
Gold Super Star: 103 stars. Many come naturally while playing; the pause menu shows which are missing.
Pict-O-Collector: Find all 6 discs of Pict-O-Matic missions
Where each disc is: Pict-O-Matic tab.
Pict-O-Master: 40 scenes. Do them once you have almost every capsule so you never doubt which piece to use.
The Emperor's Clothes: Reportedly a Zurg pod appears in Slinky's corral: step in and you come out as Zurg (unconfirmed).
Emperor Zurg Missions: The Spaceport missions given by Zurg; afterwards Stinky Pete has one more. Matches the Sheriff of the Future star.
Airborn Ranger: Buy the paratroopers ($1,500). Look for green circles with a star on high spots, throw the soldier, steer with the stick and drop with [○].
First Bronze: Earn a bronze medal in a vehicle challenge
First Silver: Earn a silver medal in a vehicle challenge
First Gold: Earn a gold medal in a vehicle challenge
Ring Rally Race on Bullseye: from the T junction facing the clock, go right to the end of the street. Gold in 40 s or less, accelerating the whole race. All three medals unlock in the same race.
Photojournalist: Only Wheezy's (the penguin) photo missions count.
No swimming: Blow up the dam and expand your town
Hamm's mission after «Mayoral Election» and «Build the Bank». Go round to the dynamite at the end and hit it with a ball.
Rescue Space Ranger: Save Mayor Hamm from the bandits

After the dam. Destroy the 5 shacks with TNT barrels. Way in: from the farm, next to the Stunt Park entrance, follow the wooden walkway on the left, wall-jump, ride the mine cart, climb, and the bandit gate is on the right.
Give Me My Gold Back: Defeat Mayor Hamm in the Woody's Roundup boss battle
Unlocks after «Marble Sculptor». Grab a TNT barrel by the bridge to the Spaceport and throw it into the tornado when the ship opens its belly. You need 3.
